job.title: Associate Structural Engineer
job.description:
This established engineering consultancy has built a strong reputation for technical excellence, practical design thinking and high-quality project delivery across the Victorian buildings market.

With continued growth across a diverse project portfolio, the business is now looking to appoint an Associate Structural Engineer to play a key role in technical leadership, project delivery and team development.

Working closely with the Directors, this position will suit an experienced structural engineer who enjoys being technically hands-on while also taking ownership of project outcomes, mentoring staff and contributing to the continued growth of the business.

The consultancy works across a broad range of building projects for both public and private sector clients, including commercial, residential, education, institutional and industrial developments. Project values vary from smaller-scale building works through to major projects exceeding $60 million.

In this leadership role, you will act as a senior technical authority within the business, providing guidance to engineers and modellers while overseeing the successful delivery of a portfolio of projects.

Responsibilities will include:
  • Technical management of structural engineering projects
  • Oversight and coordination of design and documentation
  • Mentoring and development of junior engineers and modellers
  • Supporting Directors with project strategy and design solutions
  • Managing project budgets, deliverables and timeframes
  • Reviewing and signing off project documentation
  • Liaising with clients, architects, builders and project stakeholders
  • Undertaking site inspections, investigations and construction-phase support
To be considered, you will ideally have:
  • A recognised degree in Civil or Structural Engineering
  • PE(Vic) registration
  • Approximately 8+ years’ experience in a consulting engineering environment
  • Strong experience in the design and analysis of medium to large-scale building projects
  • Sound knowledge of Australian Standards, NCC requirements and relevant design codes
  • Proven ability to mentor and guide engineering staff
  • Strong commercial awareness and project delivery capability
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
This is a key senior appointment and would suit either an established Associate Structural Engineer or an experienced Senior Structural Engineer ready to step into a broader leadership role.

A salary package in the range of $160,000 to $180,000 is anticipated, depending on experience.

For more information regarding this position, please contact Matt Sampson on 0414 916 060. Alternatively, you can email m.sampson@aspectpersonnel.com.au or apply online via the link below.

All conversations will be strictly confidential.

Privately owned, this organisation is pragmatic and fast-moving—no big-firm red tape. Decisions are quick, ownership is real, and great work is recognised. You will lead a team made up of a Maintenance Supervisor, fitters, electricians, apprentices and a parts coordinator. You will also help shape the team's future structure, including bringing on a Maintenance Planner.

  • Overseeing the servicing, repair and modification of automated processing, packaging and conveyor equipment
  • Ensuring all maintenance activities meet food safety, hygiene and high-care standards
  • Managing the maintenance budget, including spend and overtime, and working closely with Finance on cost control
  • Contributing to weekly department head meetings and collaborating with Operations, Quality and Safety
  • Supporting the rollout of new equipment and automation projects as the site expands
  • Coordinating weekend preventative maintenance and shutdown activities

About You
As the successful candidate, you will have:
  • A trade qualification, ideally electrical (dual trade highly regarded), or a relevant engineering degree
  • Proven experience leading a maintenance team in food manufacturing or FMCG. Meat or protein processing experience is highly regarded.
  • Strong technical knowledge of automation, PLCs and process equipment
  • Hands-on experience with a CMMS (MEX highly regarded) and implementing preventative maintenance strategies
  • Strong people leadership skills, with a coaching mindset and the ability to manage performance and attitude challenges constructively
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to engage with a diverse, multicultural workforce
  • Experience managing budgets and controlling maintenance spend
  • A good understanding of enterprise agreements and a strong safety-first mindset
  • The ability to be on call as required and availability during key peak trading periods (e.g. Christmas and major long weekends)
A competitive salary is on offer, along with the opportunity to join a stable, growing business that genuinely invests in the development of its people.

With a strong track record in delivering education, commercial, industrial and retail projects, the firm is known for engineering excellence and is continuing to expand off the back of recent project wins. They are looking for an experienced Structural Engineer to join their established and stable team.

The Opportunity:

As a Structural Engineer, you’ll play a role in the delivery of  building projects. Your responsibilities will include:
  • Completing detailed design and analysis on a range of building projects.
  • Collaborating with architects, contractors, and other professionals to ensure that designs are feasible and practical, and that they meet project requirements and budget constraints.
  • Conducting regular site visits and inspections to monitor progress, identify and address any issues, and ensure compliance with relevant regulations and codes.
  • Coordinating junior engineers and drafters, providing guidance and support as needed, and delegating tasks and responsibilities. 
What We’re Looking For:

We’re seeking a technically strong and delivery-focused engineer with the following:
  • Circa 5+ years of structural engineering experience on concrete and steel building projects
  • Proven capability in structural design, analysis, and documentation
  • Experience working with multidisciplinary engineers, architects and builders
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • A proactive, practical, and solutions-driven mindset
Why Join?
  • Competitive salary package: $110,000–$130,000+ (commensurate with experience
  • Clear and structured pathway to Senior Engineer
  • Formal training programs and access to industry events
  • Join a growing team with a collaborative and inclusive culture

All conversations will be treated with the strictest of confidence.

job.title: Site Manager
job.description:
About the Role
This role puts you in charge of a mid-sized new build in Melbourne's west, valued at approximately $10M. The scope is straightforward and well contained, with a full Project Manager, Contract Administrator and HSEQ team already in place to support you. You won't be carrying the site alone, and the working week reflects that, running to a genuine five days. It's a live, fully funded project with clear scope and budget from day one, backed by a builder with a secure, government-supported pipeline of further work.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Manage subcontractors and key stakeholders on site day to day
  • Drive and enforce OH&S processes across the site
  • Oversee quality assurance and ensure works meet specification
  • Coordinate delivery and drop off materials to program
  • Resolve on-site issues and disputes as they arise
  • Work closely with the Project Manager and Contract Administrator to deliver on time and on budget
 
Essential Requirements
  • 5+ years' site management experience, having owned a ground-up new build of comparable scale ($5M to $15M), multi-level and institutional in nature
  • Background with a Tier 2/3 or regional commercial builder, with direct accountability for program, quality, safety and subcontractors
  • Available on short notice, up to two weeks, and based in or able to commute to Melbourne's West
  • A stable employment history, and a clean record for medical checks, a Working With Children Check and, where required, a police check
 
Desirable Extras
  • Experience delivering social or affordable housing
  • Comfortable operating within a supported site team rather than sole-charge
  • Familiarity with Procore, Aconex, HammerTech, JobPac or MS Project
 
What's on Offer
  • $150,000 to $160,000 plus superannuation
  • A genuine five-day working week, with full site support from a Project Manager, Contract Administrator and HSEQ team
  • A manageable, well-defined project as your entry point, with a secure and growing pipeline of government-backed work behind it
  • Room to progress into larger and more complex projects with a stable, established employer
 
How to Apply
This role is being recruited through Aspect Personnel. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and encourage anyone who meets the essential requirements to apply, even if you don't tick every box on the desirable list.
 
Apply now or contact Alex Clark at Aspect Personnel a.clark@aspectpersonnel.com.au for a confidential discussion.
